Overview

Nampa is a city in ID with a population of 100,000. Treasure Valley agricultural hub with Northwest Nazarene University and growing industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.1.
